meta.title: AI chat applies a prompt to the Line Items section

plan.title: AI Prompt Updates Line Item Questions

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow needed for a Technical Stage with line-item questionnaires.
Provide the mandatory project title for the create flow.
Add a Technical Stage and pricing stage so the technical questionnaire can contain line-item sections.
Configure the Technical Stage, where the AI question chat applies changes.
Apply the first available technical questionnaire template.
Create line items so the Technical Stage has per-line-item questionnaire sections.
Populate the technical questionnaire, including the Line Items and Vendor Assessment sections, before applying the AI prompt.
Complete the technical-stage setup so the questionnaire is valid.
Open the AI chat panel for the technical stage.

args.goal: In the open AI chat panel, choose the Line Items section, record the current Line Items and Vendor Assessment question states, type an instruction to add a question about delivery requirements to each line item, click Send, and stop when the screen proves the Line Items questions changed while the Vendor Assessment questions remain unchanged in content.

steps.note: Perform and verify the section-specific AI prompt application and its isolation from Vendor Assessments.
Confirm the AI update completed without an application error.
